events.text:
My fallback pick is **00:10–00:20**, one continuous 10-second section. I can’t view the attached footage, so this is a midpoint choice—not a claim that I’ve identified the strongest moment.

I also can’t export a plain trim with the connected tools. Their video-editing tool regenerates footage, which could change the sound or framing, so I won’t use it for your request.

To make that exact cut locally with FFmpeg, keeping the original framing and sound content with no text or effects:

```bash
ffmpeg -i jet-30s.mp4 -ss 10 -t 10 -map 0:v:0 -map "0:a?" -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -c:a aac jet-highlight.mp4
```
